entries.text: Roulette now includes big brushes, colour-changing strokes, and fading ink.
Scribble players can vote on drawings while the turn's scores are shown.
Hyphenated words now show their hyphens in hints and accept guesses with spaces or no hyphens.
See recent features and fixes from the new What's new menu on home and lobby screens.
Telephone chain reveals now animate each drawing and guess as the story unfolds.
Telephone awards now show the winning drawing and its place in the story.
Hosts can return everyone to the lobby after results and start another game in the same room.
Scribble players can vote thumbs up or down on drawings and see each artist's totals in the results.
Scribble results now show a podium and let you browse every player's drawings one at a time.
Slow-loading players no longer make the first Scribble turn end early.
Using the browser Back button from a game now returns you home instead of reopening the game.
Lobbies now consistently start with 30-second turns.
Hosts can choose a landmarks and places word theme.
Your name is remembered for the rest of your browser session.
Browser tabs now show a pixel flamingo icon.
Players are no longer kicked out mid-game when an extra game server shuts down.
Your avatar customizations are saved for future visits.
Draw your own head, body, legs, and feet for your avatar.
Scribble hosts can choose default, film, or custom word themes.
Telephone turns now include game music and a final countdown warning.
Game sidebars now rank players by score.
Telephone story reveals now scroll to each new entry automatically.
Telephone: pass drawings and guesses around, then reveal how each story changes along the way.
